snippet.title: Morana Online official alpha trailer
snippet.description:
Official Alpha Trailer of the MMORPG Morana Online.

Step into the frozen world of Morana Online, a free-to-play, browser-based MMORPG set in a dark medieval fantasy universe. Discover the cursed lands of Dalmarok, engage in turn-based battles, and collect powerful loot—all without downloads. This is just the beginning: experience the alpha version and be part of the game's early journey!

Many items to discover in game !

Official Website : https://www.morana-online.com/
Game Jolt : https://gamejolt.com/games/morana-online/1009305
Itch : https://morana-online.itch.io/morana-online
